reward: terminal HV(policy) minus terminal HV(frozen shared greedy), same training instance/algorithm seed/scenarios; frozen training normalization
advantage: paired terminal return minus old critic, standardized per component with equal episode weights, fixed for this update
weighting: each optimizer step averages I/C/M losses equally; episodes are sampled equally within each component
critic: value head learns paired terminal return; critic gradient does not modify shared actor representation
tuning: First validation instance of every S0-S8 configuration, three common seeds; frozen-training HV.
confirmation: Second validation instance of every S0-S8 configuration, three common seeds; selected checkpoint and u0 greedy; no reselection.
selection: Select among u0,u1,u2,u3 by configuration-equal mean paired final HV difference versus u0 on tuning; ties earlier; u0 is eligible.
first_preview: After update1 and first fixed tuning seed for all nine configurations; diagnostic only, no early stopping.
qualification: Single member from initialization through all updates and deployment. All S0-S8 covered every update. Reused validation and 54 development pairs are development evidence; no independent-test claim.
development: Fixed existing 18 S0-S8 instances x 3 seeds. Reuse Base/shared and all old raw fronts; selected updated PPO adds 54 searches, or reuse shared if u0 selected.
